description: This PHP source file defines an API endpoint class `AttendanceEditPunchInRecordOverlapAPI` within the OrangeHRM system. The class handles a GET request to check for overlapping punch-in records during editing, including validation of parameters, retrieving attendance records, and determining overlaps based on UTC time calculations.
